QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_TEST_CONSTANT_FLOW_VALGRIND` and `MBEDTLS_TEST_CONSTANT_FLOW_MEMSAN` (`mbedtls_config.h:2109-2142`) are off by default.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the MSan/valgrind constant-flow tests are off by default, but never says they are a separate testing facility that is explicitly not part of the library API.
